question: Given that 103⁰.² = x, 103⁰.⁴³ = y and xz = y⁶ , then the value of z is close to
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Substitute the given powers directly into xz = y⁶:

⇒ (103⁰.²)z = (103⁰.⁴³)⁶

⇒ 0.2 × z = 0.43 × 6

⇒ 0.2z = 2.58

⇒ z = 2.58 ÷ 0.2 = 12.9

**∴ The correct answer is 12.9.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

x = 103⁰.²

y = 103⁰.⁴³

xz = y⁶

**Formula Used:**

(am)ⁿ = amⁿ

If am = aⁿ, then m = n.

**Calculations:**

Substitute the values of x and y in the equation xz = y⁶:

⇒ (103⁰.²)z = (103⁰.⁴³)⁶

⇒ 103⁽⁰.² × z⁾ = 103⁽⁰.⁴³ × ⁶⁾

⇒ 103⁰.²z = 103².⁵⁸

Since the bases are identical, their exponents must be equal:

⇒ 0.2z = 2.58

⇒ z = 2.58 ÷ 0.2

⇒ z = 25.8 ÷ 2

⇒ z = 12.9

**∴ The correct answer is 12.9.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Power of a Power Rule

When an exponent is raised to another exponent, the powers are multiplied: (am)ⁿ = amⁿ.

Equality of Exponents

For any non-zero base except 1 and -1, if ax = ay, then x = y.

Product Rule for Exponents

When multiplying expressions with the same base, the exponents are added: am × aⁿ = am⁺ⁿ.
